body:
🌟 Vanilla Extra: Ultimate Vanilla+ Modpack! 🌟
Vanilla Extra enhances Minecraft 1.21.10 with seamless upgrades – keeping the classic feel while boosting immersion, performance, and fun! 🎮🏞️✨
🚀 Performance & Visuals

Sodium + Iris: Blazing FPS + stunning shaders (Complementary, BSL, Photon) ⚡🌅
WaveyCapes & LambDynamicLights: Realistic waves & dynamic lights 🌊🕯️
And many more...

🏰 Exploration Boosts

Dungeons & Taverns: Hidden crypts & loot-filled adventures 🗝️
Biome Notifier: Auto-alerts for rare biomes 📍
Overhauled Bosses: Epic Ender Dragon & Warden fights 👹⚔️
And many more...

🎨 QoL & Decor

Farmer's Delight: Tasty new foods & farming 🍲🌾
Waystones: Fast base travel 🚀
Xaero's Maps + Voice Chat: Navigate & chat effortlessly 🗺️💬
And many more...

Lightweight, shader-ready, perfect for solo or multiplayer! Download now! 🚀
